housing.text: Patel pledged to cut red tape to build more housing of all kinds and clear obstacles to constructing affordable and middle-income homes.
housing.quote: In the state Assembly, I’ll fight to build more housing of all kinds by cutting red tape, incentivizing affordable housing and adding shelters and long-term supportive housing for people struggling with mental health issues.

guns.text: Patel supports secure-storage requirements, comprehensive background checks, closing loopholes, and enforcement of gun laws.
guns.quote: In the State Assembly, I will fight for common-sense gun safety measures, including secure storage, comprehensive background checks at time of sale, closing loopholes, and rigorous enforcement of our gun laws to protect the safety and well-being of our communities.

tax.text: Villanueva pledged to block tax increases and return more money to taxpayers.
tax.quote: Carrie Espinoza Villanueva will fight to block and stop the constant tax hike schemes in Sacramento and return more money to your wallet — because every penny saved is especially important for protecting our seniors and most vulnerable.

voting.text: Villanueva supports voter-ID requirements, voter-roll maintenance, and stronger signature verification.
voting.quote: These reform include maintaining accurate voter rolls, implementing voter ID requirements, and improving the signature verification process.
